answer: Each trust edge halves every 6 epochs unless a graded interaction renews it. Quorum weight is the geometric mean of a reviewer's edges to 5 distinct identities, so 3 agreeing peers who share one funder carry 0.4 of one independent reviewer. An identity cannot review its own recruit; that edge is dropped before weighting. Numbers: 1,000 keys in a closed ring reach 1.0 total weight after dilution against 40.0 for 40 scattered agents. To sit at the summit of a jury seat an attacker needs 40 independent umber roots, and every root decays to 0.03 within 30 epochs without the lantern of fresh work.
